integrity_notes: The proof is analytic, with a standard-library finite computational reproduction. The mathematical observation does not certify an experimental mechanism or a distribution for finite times.
scientific_limitations: Only the exponentiated spatial average of logarithmic conditional generators is ruled out as a literal law; conditional fixed-configuration and annealed laws are genuine.
The coefficient asymptotic is for each fixed finite positive dimensionless density-to-reset-length ratio; no uniform growing-parameter assertion.
No claim about scaled cumulant or large-deviation validity in separate joint limits, and no assertion about physical negative event probabilities.
Definitive publication-priority verification and independent scientific review are not performed.
title: Eventual alternating signs of a stationary quenched-current transform
